page.overview:
Who is Dramos?

Dramos was a Castellan of the Black Templars Chapter who commanded the Gladius Strike Force of the Rutherian Crusade.

During the Talledus War to defend the Talledus System of the Veritus Sub-sector from an assault by the forces of Chaos, Dramos and most of his Command Squad were slain when they destroyed the Soul Harvester fortress-factory Scarax Krond with a cyclonic charge.

This sacrifice saved the Fortress World of Ghreddask from being overrun by the troops of the Iron Warriors warband commanded by Warpsmith Etrogar.

When the Dark Apostle Kor Phaeron offered the Iron Warriors the chance to invade the Talledus System, the Iron Warriors warband commanded by Etrogar were tasked with containing the Imperial forces at Ghreddask, the system's formidably defended Fortress World.
